reasons: The lake record is verified for Michigan v. Jackson, identifies the court as U.S. Supreme Court, the decision date as 1986-04-01, and the year as 1986.
The official citation in the lake record is 475 U.S. 625, matching the built page citation; the parallel/vendor citations in the inventory match the lake citation list.

defect.evidence_quote: We thus hold that, if police initiate interrogation after a defendant’s assertion, at an arraignment or similar proceeding, of his right to counsel, any waiver of the defendant’s right to counsel for that police-initiated interrogation is invalid.
defect.locator_note: Correct passage appears in text/Michigan v. Jackson__e1cf9f.txt at the paragraph following the *636 page marker; lake/Michigan v. Jackson__e1cf9f.json stores a different quote for pin-636 and marks quote_fidelity as mismatch.
defect.problem: The pin-636 quote record is not quote-faithful: the lake/inventory quote is copied from the built page header/background/rule preamble rather than the U.S. 636 holding passage, and the lake itself flags quote_fidelity as mismatch. The displayed content quote is substantively the right sentence, but it uses straight apostrophes where the disclosed opinion text uses curly apostrophes, so it is not character-faithful as framed.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-636 with the exact holding sentence from the opinion text, preserving the curly apostrophes, and set the locator/page to the 636 paragraph.

reasons: The disclosed opinion text contains the holding sentence at the 636 marker, so the substantive quote can be repaired from disclosed evidence.
The inventory payload for pin-636 does not contain that holding sentence and instead stops before it after the page’s Rule lead-in.
Character-level fidelity fails because content_page.md uses defendant's while the opinion text uses defendant’s.
residual_risks: After regenerating the pin, recheck that the renderer preserves typographic punctuation from the opinion text.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use the exact opinion-text quote for pin-636 and avoid deriving quote pinpoints from rendered page prose.

reasons: Treatment/currency is outside Lens A; no Lens A support or quote-fidelity defect is raised.
The treatment fields in the inventory mirror the disclosed lake treatment fields for field_i_validity, dates, scope note, and varies_by_point.
residual_risks: Treatment/currency merits are reserved for Lens B.
